notes: The first «أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation; «أبي المغيره» is a kunya written as it stands (rule 3 of owner rulings, no identification).
«سمعت أبا الحسن ع يقول» names the Imam in the words after the chain: last link, kind imam_in_text; «ع» is an honorific and is left out.
The text writes «ره» after the first «أبي»: a blessing, left out.
